title: Special Review of Controls and Checks for COVID-19 Pandemic-related Procurement and Expenditure
what_it_is: Special Review of Controls and Checks for COVID-19 Pandemic-related Procurement and Expenditure

sections.label: COVID-19 procurement audits and guidelines
sections.summary: Agencies audit COVID-19 procurement and expenditure, and MOF is reviewing procurement, contract management and payment guidelines.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Respective agencies are conducting their audits on COVID-19 pandemic-related procurement and expenditure to ensure transactions are bona fide and that there is no erroneous payment.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: This is on top of the Auditor-General’s thematic audit of the COVID-19-related procurement and expenditure.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Drawing lessons from our COVID-19 experience and from the Auditor-General’s report, MOF is reviewing our guidelines on procurement, contract management and payment, to ensure our control measures are appropriate for future emergencies.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: MOF will also be issuing an advisory to agencies to strengthen the adoption of good practices and minimise financial risks during emergencies.

sections.label: COVID-19 fraud risk measures
sections.summary: The Government put in place measures to mitigate COVID-19 fraud risks, including pre-disbursement checks, anti-gaming framework, analytics and audit checks.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: With respect to the first supplementary question, for COVID-19, the Government had put in place a number of measures to mitigate fraud risks, such as pre-disbursement checks, anti-gaming framework, ex post analytics and post-disbursement audit checks, to identify potential abuse or conflicts of interest.

sections.label: Actual COVID-19 expenditure FY2020-2021
sections.summary: Actual COVID-19 expenditure in FY2020 and 2021 was $72.3 billion, lower than the $100 billion committed earlier.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: With respect to her second supplementary question on what is the actual total COVID-19 expenditure for FY2020 to FY2021, our actual COVID-19 expenditure in FY2020 and 2021 was $72.3 billion.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Of this, $13.4 billion was for our public health measures; $50.6 billion was to protect jobs through support for workers and businesses; and $8.3 billion was for direct household and social support.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The total amount was lower than the $100 billion committed earlier due to two main reasons.
